status_definitions.partial: A mitigation or prerequisite is implemented, but material requested architecture/behavior or validation remains.
status_definitions.pending: No substantive implementation for this task in this batch; retain original plan guidance.

known_limitations: Capture One16.7 remains unsupported; exact stable version gate remains.
Spektrafilm editing is outside native undo/redo/copy/apply/clone semantics.
Native histograms, pickers, proofing and monitor ICC behavior are not proven to describe the Spektrafilm overlay.
Current source is Capture One-developed bounded16-bit data converted to float32, not proven pre-tone-map scene-linear RAW.
Export remains16-bit sRGB TIFF/PNG; recipe exports follow its print resolution and direct exports use96DPI. Recipe profiles, metadata, naming and watermarks remain open.
Export remains capped at32MP/8192side; native preview100MP/16384side and grain-synthesis32MP constraints remain.
Floating preference Sections property is not wired; section expansion/scroll/dock-state are not persisted.
State backups remain path-keyed archives, not portable catalog identity or automatic cross-directory restore.
No global GPU-memory admission, adaptive viewport quality, cooperative worker cancellation or comprehensive performance budget exists.
Native grain restore receipts remain process-local; preserved values do not imply cross-restart restore ownership.
Runtime ffc4819 is locally installed and source is in draft PR1; no main merge or public GitHub Release has been performed. Documentation updates do not imply a new runtime deployment.
